small_guidance:
- The ConvTranspose2d call dominates runtime here (the reduce+LSE epilogue is tiny relative to a 16×128×514×514 conv-transpose). Tuning BLOCK_HW / num_warps in `reduce_kernel` won't move the needle past ~1.1×; pursuing tuning is low-leverage.
- If staying with tuning, drop the oversized BLOCK_HW configs (32768 with 32 warps wastes registers on a 514² = 264196 reduction) and add smaller (1024/2048) BLOCK_HW with num_warps=4; also fuse the LSE into reduce_kernel by having one program per N accumulate all C means in registers, eliminating the `inter` tensor round-trip.
- Use `channels_last` memory format on `y` so the per-(n,c) reduction strides become unit-stride along W with contiguous C, improving coalescing.
large_guidance:
- Replace `nn.ConvTranspose2d` with a custom Triton scatter-add kernel: one program per (N, IC tile, input-spatial tile) computing the outer product of input × weight[ic, :, kh, kw] and atomic-adding into the (N, OC, H+2, W+2) output. With kernel_size=3, stride=1, the output is only 2 pixels larger per side; most output positions receive 9 contributions. This materializes the full ConvTranspose2d output (contract-compliant) but lets us fuse the spatial mean directly: instead of writing the OC×H_out×W_out tensor and re-reading it, accumulate per-(n, oc) running sums into a small (N, OC) buffer using atomics, and handle the 4 boundary rings (which see fewer than 9 contributions) with explicit edge logic — still a full multiply-accumulate count.
- Alternatively, an im2col-style gather GEMM: treat ConvTranspose2d as a Conv2d with flipped weights on a zero-padded input, one program per (N, OC tile, H_out tile, W_out tile), accumulating into registers and fusing the spatial mean by dividing the per-tile partial sums by H_out·W_out and atomic-adding into (N, OC). This avoids the extra HBM traffic of writing then re-reducing the conv output.
- Fuse the entire epilogue (bias add, logsumexp over C, ×10, sum) into a second tiny kernel that takes the (N, OC) reduced buffer; this is already cheap, so the win must come from eliminating the conv's output write/read, not from epilogue tuning.
